data.name: Fajwa
data.gender_notes: Fajwa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The one who conquers, triumphant. The name Fajwa carries the meaning “Conquering, Triumphant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Fajwa usually hope their child will grow to embody conquering, triumphant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who is strong in her faith and overcomes challenges with grace
data.etymology: Fajwa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Conquering, Triumphant.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Fajwa total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: فَجْوَ

It reminds us of the power and strength that lie within each of us, granted to us by Allah. It serves as a reminder to stay steadfast in our faith, and to trust in Allah's infinite wisdom and guidance to conquer our challenges and difficulties.
